snippet.title: Out of the Vortex (Sep 13, 1995 prototype) - Unreleased Sega Mega Drive Game!
snippet.description:
Presenting, a late prototype of the unreleased Out of the Vortex for the Sega Mega Drive!

Developed by Cryo Interactive from 1994-1995, this unreleased game was show cased a few years ago in a much more incomplete form. Now nearly 30 years later, experience the game in a much more complete fashion with music, cutscenes, and more gameplay! Featuring music from none other than David Cage himself.

A HUGE special thanks to Pipozor who was kind enough to let us share all of this with all of you!


Read more on this prototype here:
https://shorturl.at/8HHXv
